items.title: JDF World Record Attempt on VH1's Best Week Ever
items.description:
On January 17, 2013, Jason David Frank broke the Guinness World Record of "Most Pine Boards Broken at Freefall" by breaking 7 inch pine boards before releasing his parachute during skyfall. This attempt was featured on VH1's Best Week Ever Episode 102.
